❓ How to play

  • Click the game to lock the mouse, then look around.
  • WASD / arrows move, Space jump, Shift sprint.
  • Walk to the desk by the bed and press E — the PC opens a working web browser (starts on the built-in start page).
  • T or Enter opens text chat. M mutes your mic.
  • Share the room code (click it to copy) — anyone with the code joins your private room.
  • Voice chat starts when you allow the microphone. Peers hear you room-wide.
